newsitem.title: CHINA: Air China to buy Airbus, Boeing planes this year.
newsitem.headline: Air China to buy Airbus, Boeing planes this year.

text.p: Air China will purchase flight simulators from Canada's CAE Inc to train its pilots and plans to buy an unspecified number of Airbus Industrie and Boeing planes this year, the Xinhua news agency said.
The airline plans to buy "several" A-340 Airbus planes and Boeing 777s this year, Xinhua said in an overnight report, quoting an airline spokesman.
More pilots would be urgently needed, the spokesman said without giving further details.

Air China has also decided to buy an unspecified number of simulators worth $35 million in a deal that would allow pilots to simulate cockpit conditions of Boeing 777-200s and Boeing 737s, Xinhua said.
